'''Insanity''' is one of the resources of the [[Keeper]]. Insanity is gained by performing certain actions, such as eating [[flesh]] or working in the [[Graveyard]]. Each point of Insanity reduces the maximum {{Item|Energy}} by 1. The maximum amount of Insanity is 80, or 70 with the {{Item|Iron Will}} [[perk]].

Insanity can only be reduced by sleeping while affected by '''Lack of Sleep''', consuming certain foods, or writing stories.
